content:
jon (AE): quick heads-up: MediusCare wants a POC to compare Asteria-30B (fp16) vs asteria-30b-lite-4bit. primary asks: latency profile, cost delta, and whether KV cache behavior is identical across variants. can we triage?
sara (SE): architecture wise it's decoder-only with standard BPE. tokenizer should align but need to confirm special tokens + pad handling. KV is the sticky bit for quant variants.
li (ML Eng): note: some 4-bit checkpoints pack KV differently. i'll run a checksum + shape diff. if the checkpoint's kv_dtype != float16 we need a small conversion step at load. performance wise expect memory down ~35% and throughput up ~1.6x for long-batch workloads.
derrick (Infra Eng): what's their expected POC load? this matters for autoscale config. also, which infra: dedicated or hosted?
jon (AE): want Dedicated for baseline, fallback to hosted if we need burst. target 15 rps peak, avg 4 rps, average response ~600 tokens.
sara (SE): rough cost guidance: hosted Asteria-30B ~ $0.50/1k tokens; 4-bit variant ~ $0.30/1k tokens (estimate). Dedicated pricing needs commit numbers; i'll ask finance.
li (ML Eng): can someone upload the checkpoint? i'll start validation (tokenizer map + kv shapes).
jon (AE): uploaded checkpoint to s3://medius-poc/asteria/asteria-30b-lite-2026-03-16.tar.gz. @derrick you should have access.
derrick (Infra Eng): i do. spinning sandbox Dedicated cluster now. deploy-bot: queued deploy job sandbox-dedicated-asteria-30b at 1769012800.
deploy-bot: Job started: canary deploy on sandbox-dedicated-asteria-30b. logs: https://redwood.internal/logs/1769012800
li (ML Eng): running validation script: ```
# kv + tokenizer validation
python infra/validate_variant.py --s3 s3://medius-poc/asteria/asteria-30b-lite-2026-03-16.tar.gz --max-seq 2048
```
li (ML Eng): initial check: tokenizer mapping OK, special tokens match; KV tensor names differ slightly but shapes compatible. will add a tiny loader shim to remap names. numerical delta small (~0.15% on logits).
nina (Sec Ops): security flag: MediusCare will run with deidentified data for POC but might request PHI in later stages. they require SOC2 + HIPAA controls for PHI; Private deployment needed for PHI. also need to confirm that hosted fallback doesn't retain logs.
jon (AE): they'll de-id for POC. mark PHI as enterprise blocker for later.
sara (SE): action list: (1) li to produce final compat signoff + loader shim (due today EOD); (2) derrick to produce perf numbers + autoscale suggestion (2h); (3) nina to draft SCC answers & BAA pointer (tomorrow AM); (4) jon to prepare pricing comparison snippet for AE deck (tomorrow).
li (ML Eng): perf run started: test matrix seq=[64,256,600], batch=[1,4,8]. will report P50/P95 and throughput.
derrick (Infra Eng): recommend min_replicas=2 to avoid cold-start. autoscale snippet used for sandbox: ```
scale:
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas: 8
  target_rps_per_replica: 6
```
li (ML Eng): preliminary perf (canary, Dedicated A100): asteria-30b fp16 -> seq64 p50 48ms p95 130ms; seq256 p50 140ms p95 360ms; seq600 p50 330ms p95 910ms. 4-bit variant -> ~12% faster median, p95 improves ~8%, memory down 33%.
nina (Sec Ops): SCC note: Private supports KMS/HSM, VPC-only control plane, audit logs 90d by default. HIPAA: we can sign BAAs for Private-only; hosted PII processing is disallowed. adding to thread.
jon (AE): perfect. any red flags?
li (ML Eng): loader shim required to remap kv names and ensure float cast on kv load. i'll open a small PR and run tests; should be non-invasive.
sara (SE): tagging `POC-blocker:model-compat` until li marks closed. once loader PR is merged we can flip to canary 10% -> 100% after 24h.
derrick (Infra Eng): can share canary logs once deploy finishes. deploy-bot: canary complete at 1769013200; logs: https://redwood.internal/logs/1769013200
jon (AE): i'll sync timeline with MediusCare (julia.p). plan to send a summary + pricing + SCC answers by EOD PST.
li (ML Eng): final note: for long contexts, enable KV cache and ensure `kv_cache_prefetch=true` to keep latency P95 reasonable. adding to runbook.
sara (SE): linking runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/variant-onboard. includes quant checklist and rollout template.
jon (AE): thanks team. I'll follow up with MediusCare and update here.
